name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and previous conversation

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates how logical and consistent the response is

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the response's ability to engage the user and encourage further conversation

name: Informative Value
description: Measures the amount of interesting and relevant information provided in the response

name: Contextual Understanding
description: Evaluates the response's demonstration of understanding the context and user's interests
